import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {GameWorld,platformToWorld} from '../dist/physics.js';
import {DEFAULT_VIEW,PITCH_MIN,PITCH_MAX,mouseLook,orbitDrag,orbitZoom,cameraRelative} from '../dist/orbit.js';
function grab(w,item){const a=w.platforms[item.platform];Object.assign(w.player,platformToWorld(a,item.x,item.z),{y:a.y+Math.max(0,item.y-1.2),vy:0,vx:0,vz:0,grounded:item.y<2,on:a.id});w.respawnGrace=1;w.step(1/120)}
test('extended forest and city have reachable lights and three rare items',()=>{for(const l of [0,1]){const w=new GameWorld(l);assert.equal(w.collectibles.length,l?27:25);assert.equal(new Set(w.collectibles.map(x=>x.id)).size,l?27:25);for(const c of w.collectibles){const p=w.platforms[c.platform];assert.ok(Math.abs(c.x)<p.w/2-.4);assert.ok(Math.abs(c.z)<p.d/2-.4)}}});
test('pickup awards points only once and persists through falling',()=>{const w=new GameWorld,item=w.collectibles[1];grab(w,item);assert.equal(w.stats().score,10);grab(w,item);assert.equal(w.stats().score,10);w.respawn();assert.equal(w.stats().score,10);assert.equal(w.drain().filter(x=>x.type==='pickup').length,1);w.reset(0);assert.equal(w.stats().score,0)});
test('full collection yields each level maximum and emits one reward',()=>{for(const l of [0,1]){const w=new GameWorld(l);for(const c of w.collectibles)grab(w,c);assert.equal(w.stats().lights,l?24:22);assert.equal(w.stats().relics,3);assert.equal(w.stats().score,l?390:370);assert.equal(w.stats().all,true);assert.equal(w.complete,false,'last island center allows searching before entering portal');assert.equal(w.drain().filter(x=>x.type==='allCollected').length,1)}});
test('an off-center light is picked up at its rotated position',()=>{const w=new GameWorld(0),a=w.platforms[3],item=w.collectibles.find(c=>c.platform===3);for(let i=0;i<360;i++)w.step(1/120);assert.ok(Math.abs(a.angle-Math.PI/2)<1e-8);grab(w,item);assert.equal(w.collected.has(item.id),true);const e=w.drain().find(e=>e.type==='pickup'&&e.item.id===item.id);assert.ok(Math.abs(e.x-a.x)<.02);assert.ok(Math.abs(e.z-(a.z-item.x))<.02)});
test('invisible pickups on collapsed platforms cannot be claimed',()=>{const w=new GameWorld(1),item=w.collectibles.find(c=>c.platform===5),p=w.platforms[5];p.triggerAt=0;w.time=2;grab(w,item);assert.equal(w.collected.has(item.id),false)});
test('movement rotates with all four camera headings without changing speed',()=>{for(const yaw of [0,Math.PI/2,Math.PI,Math.PI*1.5]){const move=cameraRelative(0,-1,yaw);assert.ok(Math.abs(move.x+Math.sin(yaw))<1e-9);assert.ok(Math.abs(move.z+Math.cos(yaw))<1e-9);const diagonal=cameraRelative(.6,.8,yaw);assert.ok(Math.abs(Math.hypot(diagonal.x,diagonal.z)-1)<1e-9)}});
test('orbit pitch and zoom remain bounded under extreme inputs',()=>{const v={...DEFAULT_VIEW};orbitDrag(v,6000,6000);assert.equal(v.pitch,PITCH_MAX);orbitDrag(v,-6000,-6000);assert.equal(v.pitch,PITCH_MIN);for(let i=0;i<100;i++)orbitZoom(v,1000);assert.equal(v.distance,27);for(let i=0;i<100;i++)orbitZoom(v,-1000);assert.equal(v.distance,9)});

test('mouse movement permits looking up and down without a button',()=>{const v={...DEFAULT_VIEW};mouseLook(v,120,-300);assert.ok(v.yaw<0);assert.ok(v.pitch<0);mouseLook(v,0,900);assert.equal(v.pitch,PITCH_MAX)});
